headline: Broad revenue growth, but per-share profit eases q/q
summary_short: BlackRock's Q2 FY2026 diluted EPS was $12.19, up 19.6% y/y but down 13.3% q/q from Q1's $14.06, as total revenue grew 31% y/y (+6% q/q) and assets under management reached $15.3 trillion at quarter-end.
summary_long: Revenue rose 31% y/y and 6% q/q, led by performance fees (+224% y/y), advisory & other revenue (+64%), securities lending (+40%), base fees (+28%), distribution fees (+23%), and technology services & subscription revenue (+13%). Base fees and securities lending revenue totaled $5.7 billion in the quarter. Assets under management reached $15.3 trillion at June 30, 2026. Diluted EPS was $12.19, up 19.6% y/y but down 13.3% from Q1's $14.06 -- a sequential move the release's chart-only exhibit does not explain. No new forward guidance was disclosed in this exhibit.
